sammendrag: ‘The value of learning’ is the third in the Cedefop series of reports on vocational education and training (VET) research. It covers three broad themes, published in three volumes: impact of education and training (indexed at TD/TNC 84.261); the foundations of evaluation and impact research (indexed at TD/TNC 84.262); and evaluation of systems and programmes (indexed at TD/TNC 84.263). This synthesis report is presented in four parts. Part 1, ‘Understanding evaluation’, reviews the phases and uses of evaluation in accordance with the various stages of the development of vocational education and training programs - design, implementation and assessment - and contains the following chapters: Introduction to evaluation approaches and functions; Philosophies and theories of evaluation; Evaluation traditions and cultures; Standards for evaluation. Part 2, ‘Approaches and methods of evaluation and impact research’, discusses the objects, approaches and methods of evaluation and impact research and contains: Programme evaluation approaches and methods; Impact research: approaches and methods. Part 3, ‘Evaluation of education and training in a changing European context’, discusses how evaluation can support the implementation and assessment of long-term education and training system reforms and more targetted short-term interventions as well as the role of training in combatting unemployment and labour market exclusion. It contains: Changing contexts and drivers for change in education and training; Principles, models and practices for evaluating education and training; Policy evaluation and policy learning in action; Combatting labour market exclusion: does training work? Part 4, ‘Impacts and benefits of education and training’, discusses the results of recent research on the diverse benefits of education, training and skills for societies, businesses and individuals, and contains: The determinants of economic growth at macro and regional level; Non-material benefits and externalities of education and training; The significance of education and training for company performance; Individual benefits of education and training. Included as annexes are: Key terms related to evaluation and impact of education and training; Comparing microeconometric methods of evaluation: a numeric example; Changing contexts and drivers for change for education and training: detailed tables and figures; Selected results and recommendations from the OECD thematic review on adult learning; Evaluation associations; Journals on evaluation in Europe and beyond: alphabetical list.
tittel: The value of learning: evaluation and impact of education and training: third report on vocational training research in Europe: synthesis report
